test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

The minister

P. through diplomatic ambiguity

Q. evaded scrutiny

R. on critical reforms

S. during the session
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **QPSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The minister," which is correctly indicated by the given sentence fragment.
 
• Next, the logical sequence follows with "evaded scrutiny" **(Q)**, which clearly describes the minister's action.
 
• **Part (P),** "through diplomatic ambiguity," explains how the scrutiny was evaded.
 
• **Ending with **"on critical reforms during the session" (S and R) completes the sentence, giving context to what was avoided and when.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QPSR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (RSPQ):** This option starts with "on critical reforms during the session through diplomatic ambiguity," which disrupts the logical flow and grammatical sense.
 
• **Option 3 (SPQR):** This option starts with "during the session through diplomatic ambiguity on critical reforms," which makes the sentence fragmented and difficult to follow.
 
• **Option 4 (PRQS):** This option starts with "through diplomatic ambiguity evaded scrutiny during the session," which does not establish the subject clearly.
